name: Cheesy Beef Smash Taco with Avocado, Tomato, Shallot & Cilantro

instructions.primary_message: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ tomatoes
1 ½ avocados
¾ small bunch cilantro

instructions.primary_message: Small dice tomatoes. Place on a plate.
Halve and pit avocados; using a spoon, scoop out the flesh and slice lengthwise into thin half-moons. Add to the plate with the tomato.
Shave cilantro leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Add to the plate and set aside.
Place beef, chili powder, and salt in a medium bowl. Mix with your hands until well combined.
instructions.secondary_message:
⅓ kg lean ground beef
1 ½ tsp chili powder
½ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: Arrange tortillas on a flat surface, then divide the beef mixture between them. Using the back of a spoon (or your fingers), spread the beef mixture over the surface of each tortilla in an even layer.
Preheat a large skillet over medium-high heat.

Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Working in batches, add tacos to the skillet, meat-side down. Cook, pressing down once with the bottom of a spatula halfway through cooking, until the beef is cooked through, about 3 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message: 1 ½ tsp extra virgin olive oil

instructions.primary_message: Flip tacos, beef-side up, and sprinkle with cheese. Continue to cook until cheese is melted, 1 minute more. Transfer to another plate.
Meanwhile, peel and small dice shallot. Add to the plate with the other veggies.
To serve, divide smash tacos between plates. Top with tomato, cilantro, shallot, and avocado. Enjoy!
